fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock declined 3.6%, trading in the range of $321.25–$333.81, as NVIDIA weakness impacted AI server vendors.
fields.summary_ko.1: Strong demand for AI server business (approximately $95B backlog) and raised FY2027 guidance are positive factors, while weak PC demand concerns and analyst downgrades are headwinds.
fields.summary_ko.2: Evercore maintains $650 price target with 'outperform' rating, Melius maintains $735 with 'buy' rating, yet Barclays downgraded from 'overweight' to 'equal-weight' and cut price target.
